task_summary: Implement a stateful TCP byte-stream frame codec with 4-byte big-endian length prefix and arbitrary chunk reassembly
failure_symptom: Byte-Stream Continuity Invariant: Transport chunk boundaries are completely arbitrary and independent of logical message boundaries. A decoder MUST append incoming bytes to a persistent unread buffer and loop to extract 0, 1, or N complete frames only when their full payload is present, leaving partial trailing bytes in the buffer for future calls.
